climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A Murcia DO covering eight municipalities, including Caravaca de la Cruz, Moratalla and Bullas. It is known for young reds and rosés from the Monastrell grape.
